title: Measuring and Charging Unexplained Stock Loss at a Micro Market
content:
Unexplained inventory loss at an Unattended Micro Market Program site is measured at each full count, at the frequency printed against the market format, as loss at retail value over the period against sales over the same period.

Dated-out fresh stock is credited back at the spoilage percentage printed against the market format before loss is measured, so that a fresh format is not charged for the freshness it was bought for. Loss up to the allowance printed against the market format is absorbed in full; loss above the allowance is charged to the client at the share printed against that format, and the charge names the count it rests on.

## Loss with a known cause

Loss traced to a known cause — a cooler failure, a delivery short-shipped, a theft the client has reported to their own security — is taken out of the count before shrink is measured and is never charged as shrink.

## A market shut for part of the period

Where a market stood suspended for part of the period, the allowance is measured against the sales actually made rather than against the guarantee, so a closed market never generates a shrink charge on sales it did not ring.

## The dispute window

A shrink adjustment may be disputed no later than the shrink dispute window for the market format, counted in calendar days from the day the shrink adjustment was posted. Dispute days are counted as calendar days from the day after the adjustment was posted, every day of the week counts, and a dispute arriving on the boundary day itself is in time; calendar days are never converted into full 24-hour periods.

The day the adjustment was posted is taken from the company's own record of that posting, matched to the adjustment by the reference the posting carries, rather than from the client's recollection of when the charge appeared. The comparison is not-later-than, and equality on the boundary day satisfies it.

*Hypothetical.* A dispute reaching Larkspur Table on the boundary day itself is in time. The same dispute reaching the desk on the day after the boundary day is out of time.
